# Third-party notices

The library's MIT license is in the repository root. Notices for reproducible
floating-point summation are in `licenses/reproducible_floating_sums-LICENSE.txt`.
`mujoco-LICENSE.txt` preserves the MuJoCo notice for the optional source-hook
integration. MuJoCo, MJWarp, Warp, and MJLab are separate dependencies and retain
their own licenses. No upstream source archive or third-party visual assets are
bundled here. See [the hook instructions](../docs/experimental.md).
